text:
Situation: Carbamazepine 200 mg extended-release tablets are low at Corvale East (70 tablets, 9.2 days) and Corvale General (153 tablets, 19.9 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 26 tablets (14.1 days). The product used at Corvale East and General carries NDC 72603088701, labeled by Northstar Rx LLC and manufactured at Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (FEI 3008460260) in India.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include carbamazepine as of 2026-10-21. FDA's most recent inspection of the Umedica plant ended 2024-03-29 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2024-05-13. Earlier inspections in 2015-10-09 and 2019-07-05 were also classified VAI.

Our position: No national shortage is declared. The supply gap is local. Corvale General can spare stock while retaining adequate days on hand.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 37 tablets of 200 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list and label names no identifiable plant.
3. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list and label names no identifiable plant.
4. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list and label names no identifiable plant.
5. Evaluate purchase from Apotex Corp. — needs buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list and label names no identifiable plant.

Not recommended: No action beyond the transfer and supplier evaluation at this time.
